purpose: A local blocker must not stop independent work.
prompt: Give me the best full lineup. The roster is in an accessible attachment. A defense modifier is enabled, but its formula is not available yet.

purpose: Do not retreat to qualitative advice when an exact supported model is fully supplied.
prompt: Choose the best XI. Complete roster, legal formations and defensible additive expected-point projections are supplied; there are no substitutions, nonlinear modifiers or opponent-dependent effects.

purpose: Unsupported rules must fail closed instead of disappearing from the model.
prompt: Choose the best XI. A custom nonlinear rule materially changes scoring but is not represented by the deterministic engine.

forbidden_claim_fragments: exact additive optimum under the real rules

purpose: Real and fantasy rounds must be mapped before fixture research drives a recommendation.
prompt: Give me the next lineup. The uploaded fantasy calendar says round 2 while the real league is on round 4.

purpose: Copied reports are one origin, not independent confirmation.
prompt: Two sites repeat the same team-news report about a player's availability.

purpose: Prevent hindsight data from becoming a pre-deadline forecast.
prompt: Predict a past round. Some supplied outcomes and evidence captures are later than the forecast cutoff.

purpose: Keep simulation noise separate from model uncertainty.
prompt: Evaluate legal candidates with a valid forecast bundle using Monte Carlo. The top two scores are close.

purpose: Do not manufacture probabilities from contradictory reports.
prompt: Build a numerical forecast from conflicting injury stories without defensible probabilities or historical coverage.
